(Lolla)lakṣmīdhara
alias Lakṣmī¬dhara Deśika of the Lolla line, belonging to Hārita gotra, Āpastambaśākhā, son of Viśvanātha an. Pārvatī; patronized by Gajapati Pratāparudra (1497-1539 C. E.) of Orissa. Preceptor of Deśayāmātya (a. of C. Pañcikā on Mahimnasstotra). He has written works on astronomy, astrology (a sn. of Jyotiṣadarpaṇa is also attributed to him), Mantraśāstra an. on all the six darśanas. Some of his works are attributed to his patron Pratāparudra Deva.
Composed the Koṇḍavīḍu an. Kāza [Page057-a]Inscriptions of Kṛṣṇarāya, Śaka Sam. 1442. see Epi. Ind. VI. p.. 117. 233.
Ed. by Luders.
See S. Ayyangar, Sources of Vijayanagar History, p.. 151-52.
